digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verify CI / External Integration Tests workflow
propositions: Gerrit Verify currently executes thousands of real Pandoc subprocess conversions over the complete DC wiki corpus, consuming at least 184.32 seconds of critical macOS test path time.
ADR 0095 mandates that every conversion assertion use the real Pandoc binary; this architectural decision blocks moving corpus replay to external integration without formal supersession.

The approved design moves complete real-Pandoc corpus replay from Gerrit Verify to a dedicated weekly/manual job in the External Integration Tests workflow, retaining only three representative live corpus bodies and compact probes in Verify.
The External Integration Tests workflow is currently Ubuntu-only; implementation must add a pandoc-corpus-replay job matrix for both ubuntu-latest and macos-latest platforms.
A new ADR must narrowly supersede only ADR 0095's every-assertion-live testing clause while preserving all production renderer invariants, pin/provenance probes, and platform boundary decisions.
